purpose: Evaluate S0 at a two-cell paired-radio load with actual NeuralRx
hardware: one A100-SXM4-40GB, MIG disabled, one MPS server, same physical GPU
ran_workload: two sequential valid 273-PRB PUSCH decodes per release, each with CRC and payload comparison
ai_workload: Aerial NeuralRx TensorRT FP16 CUDA Graph
selection_history: An exploratory two-cell RAN-alone run had p99 9.084 ms and maximum 16.291 ms; a contaminated manual overlap run is excluded.
interpretation_limit: Repeated decoding uses a fixed valid slot per run and zero observed misses remains statistical evidence.
